title: Build an in-memory KV store server in Go — 4 turns
description: Four-turn KV store: turn 1 set/get, turn 2 delete/list, turn 3 TTL, turn 4 persistence snapshot and tests.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `Set(key, value string, ttl time.Duration)` and `Get(key string) (string, bool)` in `kv/store.go`. Set: store `entry{Value: value, ExpiresAt: nil}` (ignore TTL for now). Get: look up the entry under a read lock and return (value, true) or ("", false). Run `go test ./...`.
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `go test ./...` to see where we stand. Now implement `Delete(key string) bool` and `List() []string`. Also add TTL to Set: if ttl > 0, compute `expiresAt = time.Now().Add(ttl)` and store a pointer to it. In Get, check if ExpiresAt is non-nil and time.Now().After(*ExpiresAt) — if so return ("", false). Continue with the remaining steps.

Good. Now implement `Snapshot(path string) error` — serialize non-expired entries to JSON. Implement `LoadSnapshot(path string) error` — read and deserialize. Run `go test ./...` and fix any failures.
Final push: run `go test ./...` and fix any remaining failures. All 6 tests must pass — set/get, missing, delete, list, TTL, and snapshot.
success_criteria: Get returns false for expired keys
Delete removes key and returns bool
Snapshot serializes to JSON and LoadSnapshot restores
